🛡️ Admin / PM / HR Hub

Tabbed control panel for Overtime rules, designations, acting roles, multi-project access, Super-User bypass & past-date edit approvals — every change saves instantly and syncs to every device.

⏱️ Overtime Control & VIP Pass

Stop or start overtime for every project at once, or pick one project to set its switch, its daily OT cap and its VIP Pass list. Every change saves instantly and syncs to all devices.

All projects — tap one to edit it

🎖️ Designation & Upgrade Engine

Search any HR Number to instantly see their current designation, site and Accommodation Status (Camp Resident / Outside Stay) — works across both the Staff and Al Muhanad Labor rosters. Upgrade their designation and, if they have a login account, their permissions update immediately.

⏳ Temporary Acting Roles

Give a user's login account temporary management permissions (e.g. Chargehand acting as Site Supervisor) with an automatic expiry — their official role and HR record never change, and access reverts on its own the moment it expires.

🗺️ Multi-Project Assignment

Assign one or more project sites to a Manager/Engineer/Supervisor's login account (multi-select) instead of just one — they'll be able to switch between their own assigned sites instead of being locked to a single project.

🦸 Super-User Admin Bypass

A master toggle that lets a specific user account bypass every site restriction and see all portal cards instantly — without changing their actual role or the Permission Matrix. Turning it off restores their normal access immediately.

✅ Pending Edit Approvals

Past Attendance/Overtime dates are locked by default for Foremen & Site Supervisors. When one of them requests an unlock, it shows up here — Approve grants a 24-hour editing window for that exact project + date; Reject dismisses the request.
